description: This file contains unit tests for the CritterIconRenderer component within the OpenClaw project. It defines a struct CritterIconRendererTests with multiple test methods that verify the rendering and functionality of icon images and status labels.

classes.name: CritterIconRendererTests
classes.description: A struct containing test methods for verifying CritterIconRenderer functionalities.

methods.name: make icon renders expected size
methods.description: Tests that the icon generated has the expected width and height, and a non-nil TIFF representation.

methods.name: make icon renders with badge
methods.description: Verifies that the icon rendering correctly includes a badge with a symbol.

methods.name: critter status label exercises helpers
methods.description: Runs an asynchronous test to exercise helper methods related to critter status labels.
